card.name: Resuming schedule after a missed dose
card.fires_on: Linking words such as then, for, taking or a comma right after a missed-dose instruction, just before the text says to resume the regular schedule. Also fires on a few other label spots such as 'Pre' in Warnings and Precautions.

modes.label: Resume after missed dose
modes.description: Link word after 'take the missed dose as soon as possible and' that leads into returning to the normal schedule.
modes.example: take the missed dose as soon as possible and<< then>> take the next scheduled dose at the recommended

modes.label: Return to schedule
modes.description: Word right before the normal daily schedule is restarted.
modes.example: Resume the regular daily dose schedule<< for>> GAVRETO the next day.

modes.label: Dose-reduction or section references
modes.description: Scattered label text such as the start of Precautions in a cross-reference or a unit in a dose change.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, though the suppressed ones are about repetition.
